diagnosis: The only failed gate was score-token presence divided by all fixture-like schedule rows. The pinned source contains both completed result rows and unresolved/unfilled schedule rows; therefore that denominator measures schedule completion/fill status, not integrity of the already completed identity population. The frozen C077-B source-selection contract explicitly allows score-field presence/nullness before numeric score access, so selecting completed score-present identities is permissible at the zero-label stage.

adjudication.type: technical source-gate definition correction before any numeric score access
adjudication.not_allowed: do not lower the frozen scientific confirmation gates, do not use numeric scores, total goals, D, T>=7 membership, predictions or losses to rescue coverage
adjudication.replacement_integrity_gate: every score-token-present completed row used by the candidate pool must parse to a valid date plus nonempty home/away identity; missing-date and malformed-completed counts must be zero

hard_boundary: This adjudication does not authorize numeric label opening. A corrected zero-label gate must pass and its exact identity manifest/SHA must be frozen before a separate one-shot confirmation execution specification can open any score values.
